title: Build initial crystal structures
action: Generate zinc-blende unit cells for GaN, BN, TlN and 32-atom supercells for B_xTl_yGa_{1-x-y}N with compositions (0.125,0.187) and at least one other.
description: Construct the starting atomic coordinates and lattice vectors for all binary and alloy systems needed by later steps.

title: Binary structural relaxation and EOS
action: Perform DFT structural relaxation with GGA-WC, compute total energy vs. volume, fit Murnaghan equation of state, and extract equilibrium a0 and B0 for GaN, BN, TlN.
description: Equilibrium lattice constants and bulk moduli for the three binary zinc-blende compounds.
output_schema: Columns: compound (GaN, BN, TlN), a0 (Angstrom), B0 (GPa). One row per compound.

title: Binary band gaps
action: Compute band structures using GGA-PBE and TB-mBJ for the relaxed binary structures; extract direct Γ-Γ and indirect Γ-X gaps.
description: Direct and indirect band gaps of GaN, BN, TlN with both functionals.
output_schema: Columns: compound, gap_type (direct/indirect), GGA_PBE_gap (eV), TB_mBJ_gap (eV). One row per gap type.

title: Relax quaternary alloy supercells
action: Perform DFT structural relaxation with GGA-WC on the B_xTl_yGa_{1-x-y}N 32-atom supercells to obtain equilibrium lattice constants for the chosen compositions.
description: Produce relaxed supercell structures required for subsequent electronic and optical property calculations.

title: Quaternary direct band gaps
action: Compute the band structure for the relaxed quaternary supercells using TB-mBJ, and extract the direct Γ-Γ band gap for at least two compositions, including x=0.125, y=0.187.
description: Direct band gaps of B_xTl_yGa_{1-x-y}N alloys.
output_schema: Columns: x (B fraction), y (Tl fraction), direct_gap (eV). One row per composition.

title: Density of states analysis
action: Compute total and partial density of states (TDOS, PDOS) for the prototype composition B0.187Tl0.187Ga0.626N using TB-mBJ.
description: Optional analysis to confirm orbital contributions; not scored but documents the workflow.

title: Dielectric function of quaternary alloys
action: Compute the complex dielectric function (ε1, ε2) from momentum matrix elements and Kramers-Kronig transformation for y=0.187 and x=0, 0.062, 0.125, 0.187 using TB-mBJ; output data for photon energies 0-30 eV.
description: Real and imaginary parts of the dielectric function as a function of photon energy and B composition.
output_schema: Columns: x, energy (eV), epsilon1, epsilon2. Rows cover the energy range 0-30 eV for each x=0,0.062,0.125,0.187.
